network_guard.meaning: no HTTP, model, vector-store or tracing client is imported here; an import-level check, not a packet capture

heat_jan2024_event_quiet_slow_resolution.label_rule: slow_resolution = resolution_hours > label_threshold_hours, closed tickets only

review_flags.borough: coarse service jurisdiction — needs a fairness/proxy review before it is served as a feature

deliberately_excluded.city: redundant with borough at a different granularity (25 of 29 values are Queens neighbourhoods)
deliberately_excluded.incident_zip: precise geography and a nominal identifier; excluded from v1 pending a privacy/fairness policy

carried_from_notebook_03.note: notebook 03's files and threshold are read-only inputs here; nothing in this notebook rewrote them

known_limits: every expected value is a January 2024 measurement over two windows of one complaint type; none of them is a forecast or an accuracy claim
the 47 ticket ids in mq-03 came from these artefacts, not an independent pull, so they pin a set rather than corroborate a number
grading wording is string matching on this v1 set; it is not a language-model judge and inherits every phrasing choice made here
the answers here are descriptive of past intake; no model was trained, no retrieval was run, no agent was asked
shares are one decimal and the threshold six, matching how notebook 03 published them; a grader must not re-round them differently
borough appears in answers under the open fairness/proxy review notebook 03 flagged
